en.headline: Eight patients and two staff test positive for influenza A at Wong Tai Sin Hospital
en.dek: The Hospital Authority said the cluster spans a chest ward and an infirmary ward; the patients are in isolation and stable, and the two staff members are on leave.
body: Tung Wah Group of Hospitals Wong Tai Sin Hospital has confirmed an influenza A cluster involving eight elderly patients and two staff members, the Hospital Authority said on Thursday.

Five men aged 60 to 95 on a tuberculosis and chest ward, three women aged 82 to 94 on an infirmary ward, and two staff members developed fever and respiratory symptoms from Monday, 7 September. All ten later tested positive for influenza A. The eight patients are being treated in isolation and are in stable condition. The two staff members are on sick leave.

The hospital said it had started contact tracing under existing guidelines and stepped up infection control. Measures include thorough cleaning and disinfection of the affected wards, tighter hand hygiene for staff and patients, and strict droplet precautions. The cases have been reported to Hospital Authority head office and the Centre for Health Protection.
The cluster comes as the Centre for Health Protection separately recorded two severe paediatric influenza cases on Thursday and said school outbreaks had risen since the new term began.

zh.headline: 黃大仙醫院兩病房爆甲流群組 8病人2職員確診
zh.dek: 醫管局指胸肺科及療養病房共十人對甲型流感呈陽性，病人隔離治療情況穩定，兩名職員正休假。
body: 東華三院黃大仙醫院確認出現甲型流感群組，涉及八名長者病人及兩名職員。醫院管理局周四表示，個案已呈報總辦及衞生防護中心。
院方指，自本周一（9月7日）起，胸肺科病房五名60至95歲男病人、療養病房三名82至94歲女病人，以及兩名職員先後出現發燒及呼吸道感染徵狀，檢測後對甲型流感呈陽性。八名病人現正接受隔離治療，情況穩定；兩名職員正休假。
醫院已按既定指引展開追蹤篩查，並加強感染控制，包括徹底清潔及消毒相關病房、加強員工及病人手部衞生，以及嚴格執行飛沫防護措施。
衞生防護中心同日另公布兩宗兒童流感嚴重個案，並指開學後學校流感樣疾病爆發數字上升。
